name: General Grievous
bannerMiniatureIdeas: A Kaleesh war mask mounted on a Separatist battle standard, draped in CIS hex emblems and battle-worn cloth
A trophy rack of captured Jedi lightsaber hilts arranged around General Grievous's sigil on a bronze plinth
Crossed electrostaffs flanking a miniature Separatist hex emblem, with IG-100 MagnaGuard cloak fragments at the base
vehicleSuggestions: TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike — Grievous's personal wheel bike from the Battle of Utapau
Belbullab-22 starfighter (Soulless One) — Grievous's custom starfighter used to flee battlefields
Providence-class Dreadnought (Invisible Hand) — flagship from the Battle of Coruscant

factionTrait.name: Marauders Champion
factionTrait.text: A marauder moves the turn token +1 step when they knock out an enemy follower.

uniqueTraits.name: Cyborg Strider
uniqueTraits.text: General Grievous cannot enter objective hexes. During his activation he may enter small followers hexes. If he ends his movement on a hex containing small followers, move each small follower into an adjacent hex.

ultimate.name: Jedi Hunter's Kill
ultimate.text: Move General Grievous up to 1 hex. Then you may choose an enemy follower within range to gain wounds until it is knocked out. You move the turn token an extra +2 steps instead of the usual marauder bonus for this knock out.

plotSkills.name: Cybernetic Bound
plotSkills.text: Place General Grievous on a hex up to 2 hexes from his current hex.

plotSkills.name: Separatist Coordination
plotSkills.text: Move General Grievous up to 1 hex. Then move one friendly champion within range up to 1 hex.

clashSkills.name: Relentless Advance
clashSkills.text: If General Grievous made an advance action this activation, Relentless Advance is a bonus action.

clashSkills.name: Twin Saber Sweep
clashSkills.text: This skill may target up to two followers that are in different hexes.

traits.name: Synchronized Guard
traits.text: Immediately after a MagnaGuard uses a skill, the other MagnaGuard may use the same skill as part of the same action.

plotSkills.name: Protect the General
plotSkills.text: If General Grievous is within range, he gains a boon of your choice.

plotSkills.name: Escort Formation
plotSkills.text: Move this MagnaGuard up to 1 hex. Then move one friendly follower within range up to 1 hex.

clashSkills.name: Electrostaff Guard
clashSkills.text: Gain {dodge_boon}. You may move this MagnaGuard up to 2 hexes.

clashSkills.name: Electrostaff Strike
clashSkills.text: If the MagnaGuards made an advance action this activation, Electrostaff Strike has +1 {damage_die}.
